$comment: Migrations that have landed in migrations/ but are NOT yet in schema.sql.
schema.sql is a pg_dump of staging, so a migration is invisible to every
test until someone applies it to staging and re-runs snapshotStaging.js.
Until that happens the suite tests a schema the code no longer targets,
and the failure looks like a missing table rather than a stale snapshot.
List a migration here when you add it. prepareTestDb applies these in
array order, after schema.sql and before seed_reference.sql. Remove them
from the list in the same commit that refreshes the snapshot.
Paths are relative to the backend root.
